about: Issue 560 turret rows for godot/bench/look_bench.gd (run with --moments res://bench/look_moments_turrets.json). Same fields as look_moments_attach.json. The attacker is the recipe cruiser C15s_23 exported with its turrets as their own nodes (tools/recipe/export7.py after issue 560); it sits unturned at (-34, 0), so z below 0 is its port side. Cells: the fire anchor is the moment the volley is called (the turrets start to turn), impact the first shot's landing; the last cells show the turrets back at rest. Every camera is a 1 to 1 pixel crop; focus_off moves the camera's focus to the aft deck between the two turrets (9 units aft of the ship's centre), so the close cameras show both turrets.

rows.label: recipe cruiser C15s_23 (corsair Cruiser, its two aft deck turrets): flak (slot 3) at a target to port, behind the beam; both turrets turn, fire, go back to rest
